"""Independent cell replay of retained reachability certificates; no LP."""
import array,base64,datetime,hashlib,json,os,platform,resource,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,zlib
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(120,120));resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1024**3,1024**3))
start=time.monotonic();stamp=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
root=Path('/home/ryan/rule30-lab');sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
p=root/'results/problem1/20260906_closed_block_potential_primary.json';r=json.loads(p.read_text());N=65536
assert sha(r['source_text'].encode())==r['result_hashes']['source_sha256']
assert sha(r['admission_note_snapshot'].encode())==r['inputs']['proofs/informal/problem1_closed_block_potential_feasibility.md']
assert sha(json.dumps(r['result_summary'],sort_keys=True).encode())==r['result_hashes']['summary_sha256']
assert sha((root/'src/python/rule30_research_reference.py').read_bytes())==r['result_hashes']['reference_sha256']
assert r['numerical']['status']==1 and not r['numerical']['success'] and r['numerical']['min_negative_margin'] is None
assert 'exact_dual'not in r and 'exact_primal'not in r
def decode(d):
 raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(d['zlib_base64']));assert sha(raw)==d['raw_sha256'] and d['shape']==[N]
 a=array.array('i'if d['dtype']=='<i4'else'b');a.frombytes(raw)
 if d['dtype']=='<i4'and sys.byteorder!='little':a.byteswap()
 assert len(a)==N
 return a
def G(x,g):
 n=x.bit_length()+3;b=[(x>>i)&1 for i in range(n)];out=0
 for i in range(n):
  v=b[i]^int((i>0 and b[i-1]) or (i>1 and b[i-2]))
  if i==0 and g!=0:v^=1
  if i==1 and g==2 and x%2==0:v^=1
  out|=v<<i
 return out
hand={0:[0,1,3],1:[7,6,6],2:[14,15,13],3:[13,12,12]}
for x,values in hand.items():assert[G(x,g)for g in range(3)]==values
cert=r['graph_certificates'];fp=decode(cert['forward_parent']);fg=decode(cert['forward_letter']);bp=decode(cert['backward_next']);bg=decode(cert['backward_letter'])
assert fp[1]==1 and fg[1]==-1 and bp[50055]==50055 and bg[50055]==-1
checks=0
for v in range(N):
 if v!=1:assert 0<=fp[v]<N and 0<=fg[v]<3 and G(fp[v],fg[v])%N==v;checks+=1
 if v!=50055:assert 0<=bp[v]<N and 0<=bg[v]<3 and G(v,bg[v])%N==bp[v];checks+=1
def ranks(par,end):
 rank=[-1]*N;rank[end]=0
 for v in range(N):
  if rank[v]>=0:continue
  chain=[];seen=set();u=v
  while rank[u]<0:
   assert u not in seen;seen.add(u);chain.append(u);u=par[u]
  for u in reversed(chain):rank[u]=rank[par[u]]+1
 return rank
fd=ranks(fp,1);bd=ranks(bp,50055)
# Recover just the stored tree path to acceptance, with no new path search.
letters=[];v=50055
while v!=1:letters.append('tup'[fg[v]]);v=fp[v]
word=''.join(reversed(letters));x=1
for g in word:x=G(x,'tup'.index(g))
assert x%N==50055
